orgName: LPGA Tour (Aramco Championship at Shadow Creek)
note: The Aramco Championship at Shadow Creek (Apr 2-5, 2026, $4m purse, 120 players) is the first LPGA co-sanctioned event in the PIF Global Series, in partnership with Golf Saudi; LPGA commissioner Craig Kessler tied the deal to 'the LET's longstanding collaboration with Golf Saudi and PIF' (LPGA news, 2025-11-05, fetched 25 Sep 2026). Whether the LPGA deal is multi-year is not stated.

source.name: LPGA - LPGA and LET Deepen Collaboration through the PIF Global Series, with the Aramco Championship at Shadow Creek Golf Club
